question_record.context: A security incident was detected involving multiple dual-purpose tools being dropped on the device `vnevado-win10v`. These tools include `domaindominance27.ps1`, `rubeus.exe`, `mimikatz.exe`, and `psexec.exe`. The process `powershell.exe` was launched with the file `domaindominance27.ps1` which could potentially be used for credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
question_record.question: During this security incident, a SID history injection was also detected on this device. Can you provide the SID value associated with the affected account?
solution: Multiple dual-purpose tools like `powershell.exe` were dropped on the device.
A SID history injection was detected involving an account with SID `S-1-5-21-1440151660-4837038288-105596163-1120`.

76.name: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped
76.description:
Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

72.name: SID history injection
72.description: A Security IDentifcation (SID) history injection was detected on this device. SID history is an attribute that supports migration scenarios. Attackers typically use attack tools to change the SID history of an existing domain user to an SID with elevated privileges. With elevated privileges, the affected process might be able to access sensitive files, ensure persistence, and modify system settings.
